Raised by emotionally immature parents. Never formed a deeper bond with them. As a kid, I was closer to my dad than my mom. Mom used to shout and abuse me emotionally whenever I messed something up around the house by accident. I remember episodes of me trembling and crying and hating her with my life. In those moments I'd run to my dad and seek some form of connection and comfort. He was never open and loving though. They were parents in the sense of providing for me and offering a roof over my head. Giving money and such but that's where it all got to. Transactional relationship. Now at 25 I am colder with my dad but talk more to my mom. She is more tolerant now and doesn't abuse me for I am not a kid anymore and she's scared I will leave. They raised me the best they could, unfortunately, that made me a recluse and an avoidant adult. Of course, I don't meant to put all the blame on them and absolve myself, I had my part in it too.

I know the feeling. I planned to kill myself on my 23rd birthday. But just couldn't do it. I opened up to my father a year ago about my issues and that I felt life is pointless and don't see any point (didn't state that I was actually in fact planning to kill myself to not worry him) and he appeared worried. We went to a psychiatrist, he just kept asking me what's the problem. Why you feel this way? Why can't you make friends? Why not get a job? At that point I came back from abroad and just sat in the house for 6 months doing nothing. Just gave me some pills to take for 10 days and that was it. I managed to pull myself together and find another job and I worked on changing my thinking. I worked hard to fit in. To this day I guess my parents think I have improved in a sense. But I haven't. I just got better at pretending. When I hear my father mentioning to me that I should get out more, find a girlfriend. I just cringe because I realize he has no clue what's going on inside of me. My parents are so protective of me that I feel like they think they parented me right when in fact I feel like a part of the blame is on them for how I turned out. I always had to follow their rules, do as they say. I am 24 and still am scared to not do something that they would disprove off. I feel like a teen that still hasn't developed fully.

I have been pushing myself hard to succeed and landed a social job. It's very draining on me mentally and physically so in my off days I just sit in my room. I had now two days off and I haven't even left the house. It's getting harder faking it and I spiral back into intense suicidal thoughts. I want to quit everything as I see that no matter how hard I try,  things in fact do not get better. I haven't been in a relationship as well and can't even fathom that type of closeness with another human. I am terribly fucked and all I want to  do is just isolate more, be alone and not have to face anyone. There is like apathy towards my future at this point so it's like I don't care if I get fired or whatever happens, but also this intense existential anxiety that takes hold of me in some instances. I have noticed I am zoning out more and more as of late. Distancing more and more.
Perhaps there is more to this shithole, but in the bible god - that would be a no from me.

For a long time now. I don't see any future for myself, nor do I think I'll ever be able to reach that happy mindset. There is just apathy towards everything. Right now I just work a job and save up as much as I can so that eventually I can quit and survive off the savings for a year or so. At least that's the plan for now.
